overall: The section's verdict survives this pass. Everything load-bearing reproduces from my own queries: the store as-of counts (all eleven tables), 677 rows = 423 episodes with RTH-L 140→14 and all 14 opened 22:10 CT 09-02 → 08:36 CT 09-03 (the 09-03 RTH low 29199.25 printed at 08:36), the 15-read candidate pool with 181 cut rows all `max_levels: 12 seated, cap 12` at score 0.0 and `score_components='{}'` on 360/360, the plan census (2,391/249, A 1,920 = 80.3 %, dedup 906/985), the eight calendar-vs-session PDH/PDL deltas, 08-27's 218.5, the 09-02 13:58 CT engine PDH 29317.25 vs 29571@00h, the ASIA D-2 plans on 08-24/25/27, the strategy config (12/1/5/B), 167 knobs, arms (67; 6 marketable incl. ids 25/27/33/34/36 of 23–37; filled 24/28/35), the P&L sums and t-stats by condition, the checklist count (78 entries, 46 absent, CLASS 75 at 2002), the hour-of-day Δ, 5/10 gap fills and 5/10 opening drives; the D1′ port is faithful to kernel/detector_d1prime.go:120-187 and both q11 and q12b re-run byte-identically from my scratch dir, so every replay and plan-forward cell in §1, §2, §3 and the appendix (~100 cells) stands, and all 66 Wilson intervals in the report check to ±0.001 (five by hand). The defects are in the framing layer, not the tape: the L11 "same code [A]" evidence is a command that prints nothing, and the planner line cites are 14 lines off on the running binary; 384 (not 110) level_state rows are consumed; the NULL-excluded position ids are the wrong ids (576/579/577, not 567/587/578); VWAP±2σ seats in 13 sessions, not 4; the pool was read 15 times, not 12; the summary's "one in fifteen" belongs to the 200+ bucket, not to ">100 pts"; EQH n=45 is mis-described as overlapping 0.5 when its interval clears both 0.5 and the replay null; and the seated-vs-cut reachability numbers that carry Recommendation 6 are one day of un-deduplicated row-reads (55/37 distinct levels), the same defect the report diagnosed in touch_outcomes. None of these reverses a ruling — retract-the-RTH-L-break, retire-nothing-under-30, fix-the-recorder and session-day PDH all hold — but Rec 6 and the EQH "no verdict" need their n's restated before they are quoted onward. Not checked: the 09-02 replay's 0.727 (n=22) / 0.625 (n=16) and grand-audit.md:74's missed-turn percentages (other reports, outside the store), and the q13 arm→level-family mapping itself (I confirmed the ids and P&L it feeds, not its 1-pt nearest-level matching).
